name: AULA F75
author: crucialjun
description: Lighting, colour, OS mode, Win lock, lock keys, battery and active-link status for the AULA F75 keyboard over USB or the 2.4 GHz dongle, with optional theme-accent sync

barWidget.description: Keyboard lighting and lock-key popup for the AULA F75

schema.label: Theme sync
schema.description: Re-colour the keyboard whenever the Omarchy theme accent changes.

schema.label: Hide when disconnected
schema.description: Hide the bar icon while no F75 is plugged in.

schema.label: Show hidden effects
schema.description: Offer the three effects the vendor driver masks for the F75 (Shadow disappear, Retinue scanning, Rotating storm).

schema.label: Battery on the bar
schema.description: Show the battery percentage next to the icon while the keyboard is on the 2.4 GHz dongle or Bluetooth.

schema.label: Battery poll (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask a wireless keyboard for its battery level.
